question: Which among the following Vedas is the oldest?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rig**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rigveda**:-

 
 
• **The Rigveda is a collection of hymns and prayers that are sung in praise of the Vedic gods.**
 
• It is the oldest of the four Vedas and is believed to have been composed between 1500 and 1200 BCE.
 
• **The Rigveda is the oldest of the four Vedas.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Vedas are supposed to be the first religious text of the Hindu religion. 
 
• Veda means knowledge.
 
• There are four Vedas __namely,
 
 
• Yajur Veda - Only Veda, which is divided into two parts (i.e. Krishna Yajur Veda and Shukla Yajur Veda), contains the knowledge of all sacrificial formulas and weapons. 
 
• Sam Veda - It is the Origin of Indian classical music.
 
• Atharva Veda - It contains the knowledge of Ayurveda, also charms and spells hence it is known as black Veda.
